text:
```yaml
name: Benchmarks

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - trunk
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  run-benchmarks:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Run benchmarks
        run: |
          chmod +x bench.sh
          ./bench.sh
        env:
          # Ensure bench.sh can use the GITHUB_SHA if needed
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Commit benchmark results
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          # Create or reset the perf branch
          git fetch origin perf || true
          git checkout -B perf
          # Add the benchmark output file (assumed to be bench.json)
          git add bench.json
          git commit -m "Benchmark results for ${{ github.sha }}"
          git push origin perf --force
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Add benchmark results to step summary
        run: |
          echo "## Benchmark Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```json" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat bench.json >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
